import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static class Rib {
        int b, u, c, f;
        int back;

        Rib(int b, int u, int c, int f, int back) {
            this.b = b;
            this.u = u;
            this.c = c;
            this.f = f;
            this.back = back;
        }
    }

    static void addRib(List<List<Rib>> g, int a, int b, int u, int c) {
        g.get(a).add(new Rib(b, u, c, 0, g.get(b).size()));
        g.get(b).add(new Rib(a, 0, -c, 0, g.get(a).size() - 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int n = N * 101 + 2;
        List<List<Rib>> g = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            g.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            x--;
            addRib(g, n - 2, x * 101, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++) {
            addRib(g, i, n - 1, INF, i * c);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j + 1 < 101; j++) {
                addRib(g, i * 101 + j, i * 101 + j + 1, INF, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int j = 0; j + 1 < 101; j++) {
                for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                    int costDiff = d * K * K - d * (K - 1) * (K - 1);
                    addRib(g, u * 101 + j, v * 101 + j + 1, 1, costDiff);
                    addRib(g, v * 101 + j, u * 101 + j + 1, 1, costDiff);
                }
            }
        }

        int s = n - 2;
        int t = n - 1;
        int flow = 0;
        int cost = 0;

        while (flow < k) {
            int[] id = new int[n];
            int[] d = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(d, INF);
            int[] q = new int[n];
            int[] p = new int[n];
            int[] p_rib = new int[n];

            int qh = 0, qt = 0;
            q[qt++] = s;
            d[s] = 0;

            while (qh != qt) {
                int v = q[qh++];
                if (qh == n) qh = 0;
                id[v] = 2;
                for (int i = 0; i < g.get(v).size(); i++) {
                    Rib r = g.get(v).get(i);
                    if (r.f < r.u && d[v] + r.c < d[r.b]) {
                        d[r.b] = d[v] + r.c;
                        if (id[r.b] == 0) {
                            q[qt++] = r.b;
                            if (qt == n) qt = 0;
                        } else if (id[r.b] == 2) {
                            if (--qh == -1) qh = n - 1;
                            q[qh] = r.b;
                        }
                        id[r.b] = 1;
                        p[r.b] = v;
                        p_rib[r.b] = i;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (d[t] == INF) break;

            int addFlow = k - flow;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = p[v]) {
                int pv = p[v];
                int pr = p_rib[v];
                addFlow = Math.min(addFlow, g.get(pv).get(pr).u - g.get(pv).get(pr).f);
            }

            for (int v = t; v != s; v = p[v]) {
                int pv = p[v];
                int pr = p_rib[v];
                Rib r = g.get(pv).get(pr);
                r.f += addFlow;
                g.get(v).get(r.back).f -= addFlow;
                cost += r.c * addFlow;
            }

            flow += addFlow;
        }

        System.out.println(cost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
